label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User-controlled param flows directly to URL construction at line 43 (new java.net.URL("http://" + host + "/v1")). Although resolveHost(host) is called earlier, the check isNOnPublicAddress operates on resolved IP, but the actual fetch uses the original hostname string. DNS rebinding window exists between resolve and fetch, plus the check doesn't cover all private address spaces (IPv6, wildcard patterns). Resolved sink value = http://{user_input}/v1 which is attacker-controlled.

evidence.note: User param flows to host var, then to URL construction at line 43 without full sanitization
